   `ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/collapse_severity_monitor/outputs/per_layer_results/per_layer_*.json 2>/dev/null`

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e

GPU_ID=${1:?Usage: run_plan001.sh <GPU_ID>}

# --- 环境 ---
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

cd /root/autodl-tmp/collapse_severity_monitor

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen/Qwen2___5-1___5B/"
SIGNAL_INTERVAL=50

# --- 双卡分配 ---
# 每卡 3 fractions × 5 seeds = 15 runs，双卡共 30 runs × 5 gens = 150 runs
if [ "$GPU_ID" = "0" ]; then
    FRACTIONS=(0.0 0.1 0.25)
elif [ "$GPU_ID" = "1" ]; then
    FRACTIONS=(0.5 0.75 1.0)
else
    echo "ERROR: GPU_ID must be 0 or 1"
    exit 1
fi

SEEDS=(42 43 44 45 46)
TOTAL=$(( ${#FRACTIONS[@]} * ${#SEEDS[@]} ))
DONE=0
START_TIME=$(date +%s)

mkdir -p logs_plan001

for FRAC in "${FRACTIONS[@]}"; do
    for SEED in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
        DONE=$((DONE + 1))
        echo "=========================================="
        echo "[${DONE}/${TOTAL}] fraction=${FRAC} seed=${SEED} gpu=${GPU_ID}"
        echo "Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
        echo "=========================================="

        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU_ID python pipeline.py \
            --fraction $FRAC \
            --seed $SEED \
            --signal_interval $SIGNAL_INTERVAL \
            --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
            --model_name "qwen15b_seed${SEED}" \
            --dataset wikitext \
            --training_mode qlora \
            2>&1 | tee "logs_plan001/frac${FRAC}_seed${SEED}_gpu${GPU_ID}.log"

        echo "Completed: fraction=${FRAC} seed=${SEED} at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
        echo ""
    done
done

END_TIME=$(date +%s)
ELAPSED=$(( END_TIME - START_TIME ))
HOURS=$(( ELAPSED / 3600 ))
MINS=$(( (ELAPSED % 3600) / 60 ))

echo "=========================================="
echo "=== ALL DONE for GPU ${GPU_ID} ==="
echo "Completed: ${DONE}/${TOTAL} runs"
echo "Total time: ${HOURS}h ${MINS}m"
echo "=========================================="
